title: Print start: homed X and Y are not homed again at the first homing and before the bed mesh (optional)

edits:
{% if 'X' not in params and  'Y' not in params  %}
        SET_KINEMATIC_POSITION X=100
        SET_KINEMATIC_POSITION Y=100
        SET_KINEMATIC_POSITION Z={printer.toolhead.axis_maximum.z/2}
        G91
        G1 Z5 F600
#        G1 X-5 F2400
#        G1 Y2 F2400
        G4 P2000
        _HOME_XY
        G90
    {% if 'X' not in params and  'Y' not in params  %}
        # q2-start-keep-xy: two homings of a print start (they send TWEAKED_KEEP_XY) keep homed X and Y and home only Z:
        # the first one of PRINT_START, when the plate check of this start has just homed X and Y, and the one in G29
        # before the bed mesh, after PRINT_START has homed everything itself. Both need the one-time mark, so Home All
        # and G29 on their own home everything.
        {% set q2_asked = 'TWEAKED_KEEP_XY' in params %}
        {% set q2_marked = printer['gcode_macro _TWEAKED_START_HOME'].xy_fresh|int == 1 %}
        {% set q2_keep_xy = q2_asked and q2_marked and 'x' in printer.toolhead.homed_axes and 'y' in printer.toolhead.homed_axes %}
        {% if q2_asked %}
        SET_GCODE_VARIABLE MACRO=_TWEAKED_START_HOME VARIABLE=xy_fresh VALUE=0
        {% endif %}
        {% if not q2_keep_xy %}
        SET_KINEMATIC_POSITION X=100
        SET_KINEMATIC_POSITION Y=100
        {% endif %}
        SET_KINEMATIC_POSITION Z={printer.toolhead.axis_maximum.z/2}
        G91
        G1 Z5 F600
#        G1 X-5 F2400
#        G1 Y2 F2400
        G4 P2000
        {% if not q2_keep_xy %}
        _HOME_XY
        {% endif %}
        G90
    SET_PRINT_SUB_STATUS SUB_STATUS=tool_head_reset
    G28   
    SET_PRINT_SUB_STATUS SUB_STATUS=tool_head_reset
    G28 TWEAKED_KEEP_XY  # q2-start-keep-xy: X and Y just homed by the plate check are not homed again
    SET_PRINT_SUB_STATUS SUB_STATUS=auto_bed_adjust
    G29
    SET_PRINT_SUB_STATUS SUB_STATUS=auto_bed_adjust
    SET_GCODE_VARIABLE MACRO=_TWEAKED_START_HOME VARIABLE=xy_fresh VALUE=1  # q2-start-keep-xy: all homed above
    G29
    {% if k|int==1 %}
        G28   
        BED_MESH_CALIBRATE PROFILE=kamp
    {% if k|int==1 %}
        G28 TWEAKED_KEEP_XY
        BED_MESH_CALIBRATE PROFILE=kamp
{% if printer["bed_mesh"].profiles.default %}
            G28
{% if printer["bed_mesh"].profiles.default %}
            G28 TWEAKED_KEEP_XY
            G28
            BED_MESH_CALIBRATE PROFILE=default
            G28 TWEAKED_KEEP_XY
            BED_MESH_CALIBRATE PROFILE=default
[homing_override]
# q2-start-keep-xy: xy_fresh is 1 only between a plate check that has just homed X and Y and the first homing of
# PRINT_START, and between the line of PRINT_START right before G29 and the homing inside G29.
[gcode_macro _TWEAKED_START_HOME]
variable_xy_fresh: 0
gcode:
    M118 A print start sets this mark; its homings read it.

[homing_override]

note: OPTIONAL (install with --with start-keep-xy). QIDI's print start homes all axes three times (at its beginning, after the filament cutter and inside G29 before the bed mesh), also when X and Y were homed a moment before. With this module the first and the third of these keep X and Y and home only Z, the same way as before (bed 5 mm down, nozzle to the middle, probe with the nozzle); expected saving at the first one about 9-10 s (the third one not measured). X and Y are kept only with a one-time mark. FIRST HOMING: the mark is set only when the foreign-object check of this start (needs ai-fixes and that check switched on) has just homed X and Y itself and went through without a report, pause, cancel or Continue. THIRD HOMING (does not need ai-fixes): PRINT_START sets the mark right before G29, after it has homed everything itself. 'Home All', the second homing of PRINT_START (after the filament cutter), G29 started from the screen or the console and a homing with X or Y not homed home everything, as before. Between the second homing and the mesh the motors stay on while the head does the Z tilt adjustment and the printer waits for the bed and chamber temperature: a head pushed by hand or steps lost in that time are no longer corrected by a new homing. No print start with it has been tried yet. Uninstall restores QIDI's lines.
